## History

Rogerson is a middle-aged lady who has taught a Sunday-school class for twenty years. She conducts the Sunday-school class that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attends alone, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) ultimately finds to be a dull experience.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P1](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XI. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--rogerson.md)

Rogerson serves as a Sunday-school teacher to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). When [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attends Sunday school alone in her plain clothes, she finds the experience dull under Rogerson's instruction, particularly when comparing her simple attire to the fashionable puffed sleeves worn by the other girls.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P1](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XI.
